content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only “item 1005” without transaction or co-purchase data. If you provide the purchase history or product association dataset, I can compute the top 10 item IDs.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 1005. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
